task:
Draw: a window with green wooden shutters and a flower box of red geraniums.
It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which every part of the district shares: An alpine Bavarian village: white plastered houses with dark carved wooden balconies full of red geraniums, green shutters, painted frames around the windows, wooden shingle roofs, blue-and-white lozenge flags; cosy and festive..
